mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 70 degrees with overcast skies near Verona Area High School, under a new moon.

The city has posted notices for the fall partisan primary and general elections. Additionally, road construction is set to begin on Highway M on August 18, which will involve traffic shifts and lane closures for the next few weeks.
There is plenty to do in town today, including Yoga at Insight Wellness and Concerts in the Park. Looking further ahead, the Cave Carnival takes place this Sunday.
On Saturday, August 8, officers assisted the sheriff's office with a burglary investigation where they used a drone to locate a suspect who had fled into a cornfield.
Today's flavor of the day is the chocolatey Devil's Food Cake. The store is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM, so be ready for a sweet treat.
